gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ysabeau-sc: Wide, confident, a bit showy up top: Bruno Ace SC keeps its curves open and its strokes unshaded. And Ysabeau SC is the plain sans below, modern and businesslike, so give it enough size that its gaping c stays easy to spot.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zalando-sans-expa: Distinctive from the first glance, Bruno Ace SC holds its line width through every turn, while Zalando Sans Expanded spaces its letters sparsely below. One shouts a little, the other just stretches out.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zalando-sans-semi: Bruno Ace SC looks like letters bent from a single length of wire, open and unshaded, with a bold sci-fi streak. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded follows with open-mouthed curves, and that gentle, modern roundness is what makes the two sit so easily together.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Sharp, spaced-out and unshaded: that is Bruno ACE SC in a nutshell. ZCOOL XiaoWei brings hairlines that are neither wispy nor heavy, so shrink the heading too far and it loses its punch beside the body.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-a: Bruno Ace SC stretches its open, unshaded letters wide, giving a headline real presence. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique gives smooth bends and a t with matching crossbar and stem, so it holds up best at a comfortable, generous size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Bruno Ace SC is the show-off here, spacing out open-aperture letters with a distinctive, expressive swagger. Zen Maru Gothic is the quiet reader, a plain sans whose bowls never close up and whose lines flow like following a single thread.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-ibm-plex-sans: Bruno Ace SC draws monoline strokes with open apertures, giving the heading a distinctive, expressive look. And IBM Plex Sans lets a wide channel into every bowl, so paragraphs feel technical yet approachable all the way down.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-nunito: Chunky, flat-weighted and a bit cheeky: that is Cherry Swash. Nunito sits beside it with big round bowls and terminals that finish clear of the stem, softer and friendlier, a plain sans that lets the heading keep its swagger.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-asta-sans: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe and gives its diagonals the same heft as its verticals. Asta Sans answers with tubelike, constant lines, quieter and friendlier.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bai-jamjuree: Horseshoe c, heavy diagonals, real attitude. Cherry Swash does the commanding, distinctive work up top, while Bai Jamjuree stays approachable beneath it, its round letters light and unpinched with no thick-and-thin modulation at all.
